captions.linkedin:
Concept redesign: a fictional café homepage, rebuilt for the phone.

The old version looks nice and answers nothing. Five photos to swipe, an 8 MB PDF menu, an Instagram feed that loads before anything useful, and the hours at the very bottom.

The new one puts today's hours and "open now" at the top, has one button to order, shows the menu as text and keeps the map one scroll down.

Not a client project. If your site does any of this, I'm happy to take a look: prycedigital.com/book
